text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0842 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on rain on the arid southeast Prairies. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +0.97 Monday from -1.61 Friday. Canada's dollar fell to C$1.3870 versus the U.S. dollar, rose to 81.87 yen, rose to 1.2487 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.30 to C$0.80 down on rain in the flaxbelt.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn calls with commercial scale down demand expected to begin at C$130.50 in the July. Rain should weigh on values.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on rain on dry areas of the Prairies. Alberta Wheat Pool was expected to resume selling wheat spreads as commercials liquidate July longs.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 up as Louis Dreyfus market-on- close selling Monday was considered overdone.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
